basis.description: the values the members share (the grouping key)
basis.title: Basis

cluster_id.description: stable for the same members and rule: kind + ':' + 12 hex
cluster_id.title: Cluster Id

path.description: an absolute path of a PDF inside scan_roots
path.title: Path

gap.description: open gap codes, counted with every filter except `gap`
gap.title: Gap

enabled.description: configured and the key's environment variable is set
enabled.title: Enabled

remote.description: region images and text are sent to an external service
remote.title: Remote

bbox.description: where to highlight: the cell's box for a cell, else the region's box
bbox.title: Bbox

snippet.description: the matching text with the hits between « and »
snippet.title: Snippet

source.description: what matched: the region's text, a table cell, or an LLM description
source.title: Source

bbox.description: where to look: the gap's own box (find_tables), else the region's or table's box; null for a page-level item
bbox.title: Bbox

item_id.description: stable across review; pass to the `ack` op and to /queue/seen
item_id.title: Item Id

Region.description: A region: label-stage (with docling_label, classes; no status yet) or current (contract/v2 region).
Region.title: Region

next_cursor.description: pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

gaps.description: codes of the region's open gaps
gaps.title: Gaps

llm.description: kinds of LLM output the region has
llm.title: Llm

text_preview.description: the first 200 characters of the region's text (text by box from the text layer where the region has none)
text_preview.title: Text Preview

ops.description: the review operations so far, in order (review.jsonl without the final confirm row)
ops.title: Ops

target.description: ack rows: the queue item answered

updated.description: items that were not marked seen before
updated.title: Updated

workflow.description: the parsed workflow; null when the text is invalid
workflow.title: Workflow

get.description: Groups of similar regions (two or more members each); a group changes no data.

Counts per type, status and open gap code for the same filters as /regions; each dimension is counted
without its own filter.
LLM outputs of the job (llm.jsonl rows) and progress per use.

The review inbox: gaps and weak continuation hints grouped by problem, each open, seen or resolved (empty
before extraction).

post.description: Mark queue items as shown to the reviewer (work state only; never delivered).

get.description:
Regions in reading order: label-stage before extraction, current after. `q` searches region text, table
cells and LLM descriptions (every word as a prefix); repeat `type`, `status`, `gap` for several values.
The job's source file, with HTTP Range (PDF.js loads pages on demand).
The document summary (LLM, low weight); `off` when the LLM is not enabled.
